### Power Point - Sept. 22, 2006
Author: PowerPoint Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-sept-22-2006-1427381.html
Passage: Proverbs 28:1
Points:
- The enemy uses subtle temptation when direct accusations fail to defeat believers.
- Nehemiah modeled holy boldness instead of cowardice by refusing to compromise God's commands.
- Righteous living removes the fear and guilt that cause people to run away in distress.
- Daily engagement with Scripture imparts the discernment needed to spot spiritual traps.

### Stop the Blame Game
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-march-20-2013.html
Passage: Proverbs 28:13
Points:
- Refusing a positive outlook often draws people into self-pity or endless blame.
- Blaming oneself magnifies lingering guilt and fixes attention on an unchangeable past.
- Blaming God cuts off spiritual strength and allows bitter cynicism to replace trust.
- Accusing others widens relational divides while leaving the core problem unsolved.
- Real healing and mercy come only when we confess our wrongs rather than concealing them.
